folds.heading: ## Superseded-text and reader-contract reconciliation, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
Full reading of SUPERSEDED_TEXT, ROUND2_SUPERSEDED_TEXT and ROUND3_SUPERSEDED_TEXT preserves the removed wording as history. Their initial proposal statuses are not current authority; neither are blanket conservation, body-only fluency, forced frozen-time costs, secret-clue bans, internal sealed-file reading bans, anti-farm rules or narrow viewport gates. PCR/PA2 and later live owners explain those corrections. The preserved reset/commit/resume fragments are not execution instructions (AD32, AD36).

The round5 READER_BRIEF is a historical finite extraction contract, not current approval to spawn workers or stop this reconciliation. Its important content controls remain useful: read the assigned source through its actual delimiters, recover omitted spans, retain exact IDs/ranges/input identity, and distinguish a promised output from delivery. Hashes, preparation counts and transport-part endings establish none of that semantic coverage. No underlying Snnn/raw source is newly reviewed by reading this charter; existing semantic receipts retain their own scope.

Useful original variants remain in the archive rather than being deleted, restored as live rules or silently called accepted. This pass does not implement any formerly proposed migration, market, traveler, training-world or UI change.

folds.heading: ## Evidence-recipe content reconciliation, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
The evidence-directory README describes comparable seeded UI fixtures: post-elder routing followed by 29 common inventory stacks, 5000 money, unlock flags and XP in 14 skills. These states support the dated density comparison, not naturally earned progress or all original save-loader behavior. Meditation was omitted because its injected reward crashed the original loader, and the emulated 150% PLAY route required an artificial scripted click. Keep those exclusions/workarounds when interpreting the figures.

The named ports, scratch worktrees and hardcoded fixture paths are historical reproduction inputs, not currently verified services or permission to recreate a profile. The report identifies a measured bundle; its newer-than-source timestamps alone are not a source-content equivalence proof or a fresh rebuilt result. No screenshot, measurement JSON, private save or driver was rerun here. Current desktop and text-size owners govern a selected UI change, while this archive preserves its original viewport/zoom comparisons and evidence limits (AD32, AD36, AD43).
